title: DGAC Violations of Ley 16.752 (Organic Law) — Specific Article Violations During LA8159 Complaint Processing

confidence.derivation_formula: value = round( sum_per_article( applicability_weight × element_grid.weighted_score ) / sum_of_weights × authorities_verification_factor, 2 ); authorities_verification_factor = 0.85 + 0.15 × verified_ratio = 0.850

allegation_summary: DGAC systematically violated its own Organic Law (Ley 16.752) during processing of the passenger's complaint (Expediente N°15126, opened November 6, 2025). DGAC officials imposed multiple procedural obstacles — initially claiming no access to the system, then requiring .zip format resubmissions — while CC'd supervisors never intervened. The complaint processing violated specific articles of Ley 16.752 governing DGAC's duties regarding civil aviation safety, passenger protection, and proper administrative procedure. Three different DGAC officials handled the case with no continuity, and the investigation failed to address the core complaint: that PDI had already determined the passenger committed no offense.
